meta.name: stakeholder-engagement-advisor
meta.description: Plan engagement for a specific stakeholder. Use when preparing an outreach, navigating resistance, or aligning a critical relationship before a key milestone.

copy.tagline: 规划关键干系人的沟通策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在重要节点前对齐关键人物关系。
copy.tagline_en: Plan engagement strategies for key stakeholders
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to align critical relationships before a key milestone.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你回答三个问题，然后生成一份针对特定利益相关者的沟通计划，包括关键信息、沟通方式、频率、双方需求以及下一步行动。
howto.when: 当你需要与某个利益相关者进行重要沟通、应对阻力或协调关键关系时触发。例如，在路线图评审前或与持反对意见的人接触时。

say.text: 帮我规划如何与VP销售沟通，他在QBR前两周公开支持但不断升级例外。
say.note: Claude会引导你完成诊断并生成计划。

say.text: 我有一个持反对意见的利益相关者，如何接近他？
say.note: Claude会分析情况并推荐沟通策略。

say.text: 我需要让一位新的执行发起人快速了解情况。
say.note: Claude会提供针对性的沟通方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through three questions and then generate a tailored engagement plan for a specific stakeholder, including key message, medium, cadence, mutual needs, and a named next action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to plan engagement for a specific stakeholder, such as before a critical conversation, milestone, or when navigating resistance. Use when preparing outreach or aligning a key relationship.

say_en.text: I have a resistant stakeholder — how do I approach them?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the situation and recommend a strategy.

say_en.text: I need to bring a new executive sponsor up to speed quickly.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a tailored engagement approach.
